challenges.title: Totals and counts with collections
challenges.prompt: Implement total(items) with fold (sum of qty x price) and countByInitial(items) returning the total quantity per upper-cased first letter of the item name. Print the total to two decimals and the map.
challenges.explain: fold accumulates a running sum, and a map with `?? 0` accumulates per-key totals. Dart prints maps as {A: 5, B: 1}. Verified by running the solution with the Dart SDK.

challenges.title: Typed exceptions and streams
challenges.prompt: Complete Account.withdraw (ArgumentError for non-positive amounts, a custom InsufficientFunds exception when over balance), and an async* generator ticks(n) that yields 1..n. The provided main handles each failure type and uses finally.
challenges.expected:
withdrew 30, balance 70
checked 30
error: InsufficientFunds(short by 30)
checked 100
invalid: amount must be positive
checked -5
sum of ticks: 10
challenges.explain: Catch the most specific exception types first, use finally for always-run code, and async* with yield to produce a Stream. Verified by running the solution with the Dart SDK.
